notes: Coverage: every visible text block and every inline/display formula was read against both C and H, including agreed words, all endings and punctuation, accents, category numerals, primes, underlines, indices, arrows and parentheses. The entire handwritten page was checked; no source privacy placeholder or editorial prose was substituted for ink.

Workflow: the whole image was opened once for layout, half_a once and half_b once in that order. Fifteen tight crops were then made from the whole source solely for the remaining open loci and viewed once each. No whole image or half was reopened, no settled locus was recropped, and no OCR, recognition software, PDF text layer, external source or other scan was used. crop_manifest.json is an intermediate manifest; the authoritative processed-crop readings are in this report.

Uncropped differences settled in the halves are explicitly labelled in changes and have approximate whole-source pixel boxes. These boxes are retained-observation metadata for the main reader's adjudication crops; they were not obtained by reopening images.

The page is a fully handwritten continuation beginning donc and ending près des. It has no new title, date, salutation, signature, manuscript page number or total. The visible lower-left archive number is 9. The main pen layer and pale footer layer are left unattributed.

The opening paragraph states that E'(M,N) has the invariants of E(M,N) in degree i+2 and gives the degree-2 exact sequence. The P(M,N) identification is physically above the middle term. These statements and formula shapes were transcribed, not mathematically proved in this run.

The heuristic paragraph interprets E prime using a 2-champ of Picard and explicitly assumes that ta théorie for strict 1-champs extends to strict 2-champs, adding ce qui pour moi ne fait guère de doute. It then relates E(M,N) to strict Picard champs. The inserted épingling phrase and inserted stricts are attached with ordinary insertion hooks, not independent drawings.

The final paragraph says the exact sequence is constructed en tous cas canoniquement, quoted à la main, and begins to describe its middle term. The page stops after près des. Its exact final noun and the cancelled old article/preposition remain uncertain; no grammatical repair or completion has been supplied.

C alert coverage: E/E prime, H and i, the star, Ext and its exponent, the top brace/P label, Hom's underline and low-left 2, all quotation strokes and every ordinary capital were checked. The thirteen actual C doubt loci are all represented in changes, whether resolved, retained or expanded. Wholly agreed mathematical alert entries are recorded in notation rather than counted as changes.
All image-based comparisons in this report are visual transcription checks. No proof, computation, formal certificate or independent mathematical re-proof was performed, so math_checks is empty.

H's insertion note was credited for the raised épingling phrase and stricts, and H's page{9} was treated as metadata matching the archive footer. Neither macro renaming nor those already-reported source insertions was counted as an H omission.
